ModuleTitle.helper: Used by OpenContent and DNN module settings. This is not displayed to site visitors.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Creates a page anchor for direct links to this section. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

SectionEyebrow.helper: Optional. A short label above the section title. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.

SectionEyebrowColor.helper: Optional. Choose the color of the section eyebrow.

SectionTitle.helper: Optional. The main heading above the timeline. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.

SectionDescription.helper: Optional. Introduce the story in one or two short paragraphs. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
SectionDescription.placeholder: Introduce the milestones visitors are about to explore.

Moments.label: Timeline Moments
Moments.helper: Add moments in chronological order. Each moment appears as a card on the timeline.

MomentTitle.helper: Required. Add a concise title for this milestone. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.

MomentEyebrow.helper: Optional. Add a year, period, or short label above the title. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.

MomentDescription.helper: Optional. Explain why this moment matters. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
MomentDescription.placeholder: Explain what happened and why it matters.

MomentImage.helper: Optional. Choose an image for this moment. Uploads are stored in Content/Timeline/.

MomentShape.helper: Required. Choose the marker shape used for this moment.

MomentShapeColor.helper: Required. Choose a marker color. The template selects contrasting marker text automatically.

MomentDateTime.helper: Required. Enter the date associated with this moment. It is also exposed to assistive technology.

LinkText.helper: Optional. Add the visible text for the moment link. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.

LinkUrl.helper: Optional. Select a local page or enter a complete http or https URL. When provided, the content card becomes a link.

LinkIcon.helper: Optional. Find icons at FontAwesome

SectionFooter.helper: Optional. Add a short centered note below the timeline. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
